The present application under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, has been filed to quash the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 26779 of 2022, (State Vs. Vinay Kumar) arising out of Case Crime No. 387 of 2020, under Sections 420, 406, 120-B of I.P.C., Police Station- Bilsi,

opennyai_summary.final__ANALYSIS:
